chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. He said: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Jarir al-Tabari narrated to us. He said: Abu Muhammad al-Hasan ibn Abd al-Wahid al-Khazzaz narrated to us. He said: Isma'il ibn Ali al-Sindi narrated to me, from Muni' ibn al-Hajjaj, from 'Isa ibn Musa, from Ja'far al-Ahmar, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon him). He said: I heard Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari say: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said:

On the Day of Resurrection, my daughter Fatima will come forward on a she-camel from the camels of Paradise, its sides adorned, its muzzle of fresh pearl, its legs of green emerald, its tail of fragrant musk, and its eyes of red rubies. Upon it will be a dome of light whose exterior can be seen from within and whose interior can be seen from without. Inside it is the forgiveness of God, and outside it is the mercy of God. Upon her head is a crown of light. The crown has seventy pillars, each inlaid with pearls and rubies, glowing just as a brilliant star glows on the horizon of the sky. On her right are seventy thousand angels, and on her left are seventy thousand angels. Gabriel is grasping the muzzle of the she-camel, calling at the top of his voice: Lower your gazes until Fatima daughter of Muhammad passes!

Then on that day, there will not remain a prophet, nor a messenger, nor a truthful one, nor a martyr, but that they lower their gazes until Fatima daughter of Muhammad passes through. She proceeds until she is alongside the Throne of her Lord, exalted be His majesty. She dismounts from her she-camel and says: My God and my Master! Judge between me and those who oppressed me. O God, judge between me and those who killed my son. Then there comes a call from the direction of God, exalted be His majesty: O My beloved and daughter of My beloved! Ask Me and you will be granted, and intercede and your intercession will be accepted. For by My glory and My majesty, no injustice of an oppressor has escaped Me. Then she says: My God and my Master! My offspring, my Shi'a, the Shi'a of my offspring, those who love me, and those who love my offspring. Then there comes a call from the direction of God, exalted be His majesty: Where are the offspring of Fatima, her Shi'a, those who love her, and those who love her offspring? They come forward, surrounded by the angels of mercy. Fatima leads them until she enters them into Paradise.

key_terms.ذرية: Offspring, descendants — referring to the progeny of Lady Fatima and Imam Ali
key_terms.شفاعة: Intercession (shafa'a) — the right to plead on behalf of others before God on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.شيعة: Shi'a — the devoted followers and partisans of the Ahlulbayt
key_terms.فاطمة: Fatima al-Zahra (AS), the beloved daughter of Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) and wife of Imam Ali (AS)

ai.seo_question: What is the hadith about Lady Fatima's intercession on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: This prophetic hadith, narrated through Imam al-Baqir (AS) from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari, describes the exalted arrival of Lady Fatima al-Zahra (AS) on the Day of Resurrection. She rides a magnificent she-camel from Paradise, adorned with precious gems, accompanied by 140,000 angels and led by Gabriel. She dismounts before God's Throne to seek justice for the wrongs done to her and her children, and God grants her intercession for her offspring, followers, and those who love her and her progeny, whom she then leads into Paradise.
